accepted.s: Which WTO subsidy box covers trade-distorting domestic support that is subject to a cap based on de minimis limits?
accepted.x: Amber Box subsidies are trade-distorting domestic support measures and are subject to prescribed limits, including de minimis ceilings.
accepted.tq: Use the exact subject-function association to distinguish the subsidy boxes.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: Support tied to production-limiting programmes is classified under which WTO subsidy box?
accepted.x: Blue Box support is linked to programmes that limit production.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the closely related Amber, Blue and Green subsidy categories.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Green Box measures are regarded as having minimal or no trade distortion.
2. Green Box support is not subject to a cap.
3. Green Box measures are exclusively related to intellectual property rights.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Green Box measures have minimal or no trade-distorting effects and are not capped. Intellectual property rights are covered by TRIPS, not the Green Box.
accepted.tq: Find the statement that swaps a subsidy category with a neighbouring WTO agreement.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: TRIPS, an agreement administered within the WTO framework, primarily deals with:
accepted.x: TRIPS stands for Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights.
accepted.tq: Test the expansion and precise subject of a commonly confused acronym.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: TRIMs is concerned with:
accepted.x: TRIMs refers to Trade-Related Investment Measures.
accepted.tq: Separate look-alike WTO acronyms by their exact subject.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding GATT is correct?
o: It was signed in 1994 and came into force in 1995.
It was signed in 1947 and came into force in 1948.
It was signed in 1986 and came into force in 1991.
It was signed in 1948 and came into force in 1947.
accepted.x: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade was signed in 1947 and entered into force in 1948.
accepted.tq: Use the chronological pair to catch a reversal of the signing and enforcement years.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: GATT originally had how many parties when it was established?
accepted.x: GATT had 23 original parties.
accepted.tq: Recall the specific founding number rather than confusing it with institutional membership figures.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: The Most-Favoured-Nation clause is associated with which of the following?
accepted.x: The Most-Favoured-Nation clause is a fundamental principle associated with GATT.
accepted.tq: Match a distinctive principle with the correct international agreement.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Uruguay Round was the eighth round of multilateral trade negotiations under GATT.
2. It commenced in 1986.
3. It resulted in the creation of the WTO on 1 January 1995.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Uruguay Round was the eighth GATT round, began in 1986 and led to the WTO, which came into existence on 1 January 1995.
accepted.tq: Combine the round number, starting year and institutional outcome in one statement set.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: Which of the following subjects was included among the major outcomes of the Uruguay Round?
o: Farm subsidies, services and intellectual property
accepted.x: The Uruguay Round addressed agriculture and farm subsidies, trade in services and intellectual property rights, among other matters.
accepted.tq: Identify the option containing the complete cluster of related subjects.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: The Dunkel Draft of 1991 was associated with proposals made by:
accepted.x: The Dunkel Draft contained proposals made by Arthur Dunkel, the Director-General of GATT, during the Uruguay Round.
accepted.tq: Use the person–institution–document association rather than a general economic personality link.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: The Peace Clause agreed at Bali in 2013 primarily protects developing countries from WTO disputes concerning:
accepted.x: The Bali Peace Clause shields developing countries' public food-stockholding programmes from disputes over Amber Box limits until a permanent solution is found.
accepted.tq: Apply the agreement to the specific policy situation it was designed to protect.
accepted.sec: WTO agreements and subsidy boxes - Amber, Blue, Green, TRIPS, TRIMs, Dunkel Draft, GATT

accepted.s: The Bretton Woods Conference was held in:
accepted.x: The Bretton Woods Conference took place in 1944. Its ideas were associated with Harry Dexter White and John Maynard Keynes.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the conference year from the later establishment and operational years of the institutions.

accepted.s: Which pair is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The IMF formally came into existence on 27 December 1945, while its operations began on 1 March 1947.

accepted.s: The first borrower from the International Monetary Fund was:

accepted.s: The headquarters of the International Monetary Fund is located in:

accepted.s: Which institution generally provides loans for middle-income countries' public infrastructure?
accepted.x: The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development provides loans mainly for public infrastructure in middle-income countries.

accepted.s: Long-term interest-free credits and grants for health and primary education are characteristic of:
accepted.x: The International Development Association provides long-term interest-free credits and grants, including for health and primary education.
accepted.tq: Match the concessional financing instrument with the correct World Bank institution.

accepted.s: Which of the following is the private-sector arm of the World Bank Group?
accepted.x: The International Finance Corporation is the private-sector arm of the World Bank Group and has 184 members.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional mandate hidden among similar abbreviations.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about IMF lending:
1. The IMF lends only to its member countries.
2. Its lending is intended to address balance-of-payments problems.
3. The Rapid Financing Instrument requires a full economic programme in every case.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The IMF lends only to members and primarily addresses balance-of-payments problems. The Rapid Financing Instrument provides quick liquidity without requiring a full programme.
accepted.tq: Locate the reversed condition in a statement about an institutional lending instrument.
accepted.sec: Bretton Woods institutions - IBRD, IDA, IMF functions, loan types, membership

accepted.s: The IMF loan facility described as providing quick liquidity without a full programme, including during disasters, pandemics and post-conflict situations, is:
accepted.x: The Rapid Financing Instrument provides rapid liquidity without a full programme in emergencies such as disasters, pandemics and post-conflict situations.
accepted.tq: Match the emergency scenario with the facility designed for rapid access to funds.
accepted.sec: Bretton Woods institutions - IBRD, IDA, IMF functions, loan types, membership

accepted.s: Which IMF facility was associated with the softest terms?
accepted.x: The Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility, or ESAF, had the softest terms among the facilities mentioned.
accepted.tq: Distinguish concessionality from speed and from the mandates of other institutions.
accepted.sec: Bretton Woods institutions - IBRD, IDA, IMF functions, loan types, membership

accepted.s: During the 1991 crisis, India received approximately what amount from the IBRD and IMF combined?
accepted.x: India received approximately $7 billion from the IBRD and IMF during the 1991 crisis, followed by the New Economic Policy.
accepted.tq: Select the specific historical financial figure rather than a later programme amount.
accepted.sec: Bretton Woods institutions - IBRD, IDA, IMF functions, loan types, membership

accepted.s: Which combination best describes the structural adjustment programmes of the 1980s and 1990s?
o: Debt cancellation, disarmament and refugee resettlement
Public food stocking, tariff abolition and gold accumulation
Universal subsidies, nationalisation and currency appreciation
accepted.x: Structural adjustment programmes commonly involved austerity, privatisation and devaluation; studies linked them to rising poverty and inequality in the Global South.
accepted.tq: Identify the complete policy cluster associated with structural adjustment programmes.
accepted.sec: Bretton Woods institutions - IBRD, IDA, IMF functions, loan types, membership

It was established in 2016 and has 111 approved members.
It was established in 2023 and has 184 approved members.
It was established in 1995 and has 29 approved members.

A common agricultural subsidy fund of the WTO
An alternative source of IMF-type liquidity support for BRICS members

accepted.s: Which statement correctly describes India's commercial-services trade in 2024?
o: India was the fourth-largest exporter with a 15.73% share and the sixth-largest importer with an 8.85% share.
India was the ninth-largest exporter with a 3.4% share and the eighth-largest importer with a 4.3% share.
